title: Recreating Iron Age Village Life
titleZh: 重建铁器时代的村落生活

questions.question: Jim says that in the Iron Age village

analyses.content: 录音中提到因为这里天亮得早，他每天都会早起（do it every day），对应选项B“总起得很早”。
你可能会因为听到“time to myself”或“cold”误选C或A，但录音中明确说有自己的时间是他以前在家的习惯，而觉得晚上冷的是其他人（Others）。

A typical day in the Iron Age village begins with rising at first light. I occasionally did that when I was at home because I loved having time to myself before the family got up. But here I do it every day because it's so light. Others also get up early because they find the straw beds rather cold.

questions.question: What does Jim say about the food they eat in the village?

analyses.content: 录音中明确指出做任何食物都需要很长时间（takes such a long time to cook anything），对应选项A“需要时间准备”。
这一题比较直接，只要跟上录音里的“long time to cook”，就不会因为主观猜测而去选未提及的B（难以习惯）或C（吃得快）。
As it takes such a long time to cook anything, we end up eating only twice a day.

questions.question: Jim says that at the evening meal

analyses.content: 录音中提到晚餐提供了一个让大家交流白天活动的机会（chat about the day），对应选项C“谈论他们做过的事”。
你可能会因为听到后面的“go to bed pretty early”觉得他们很累而误选A，但录音中早睡是因为冷（chilly），而不是累得吃不下饭。

We have a late breakfast after a morning's work, and then in the evening we gather together as a community. Although the evening meal provides a chance for us to chat about the day, it can be quite chilly, so we go to bed pretty early.

questions.question: The most important job for the blacksmiths is

analyses.content: 录音中强调铁匠的首要任务（biggest priority）是照看炉火并让它保持高温（get it nice and hot），对应选项B“维持良好的热源”。
你可能会因为听到前一句的“finding wood”或后半句的“tasks”而误选C或A，但录音明确说了生火和保持高温才是铁匠最大的重点。

There are lots of other jobs to be done, like cooking, finding wood, and keeping the fires going. The biggest priority for the blacksmiths working the forge is to tend the fire and to get it nice and hot so they can carry out their tasks.

questions.question: Jim likes the fact that in the village, people

analyses.content: 录音提到在这里每天都能学着做不同的事情（different things every day），这让他保持兴趣，对应选项A“进行多样的活动”。
你可能会觉得村落生活就是知识共享或者体力劳动，从而主观误选B或C，但答案句的核心只强调了事情的多样性（different things）。
Here, you're finding out how to do different things every day, which keeps you on your toes and keeps you interested.

analyses.content: 录音直接提到用木桩（wooden peg）标记房子的中心，对应选项G（peg）。
图表填空容易听漏，但只要紧跟“center”这个定位词，就能直接抓取到随后的“peg”。
You mark the center of your house with a wooden peg.
录音提到当时的人们使用动物骨头（animal bone）制成的工具来挖地，对应选项A（bone）。
你可能会被录音里提到的现代工具“shovels or diggers”干扰，但录音明确说明当时并没有（didn't have）这些，而是使用了骨头。

Once you've got this, you then have to dig out the ground ready for the wall. And in Iron Age times, people didn't have shovels or diggers like we do today, but used tools which they fashioned from animal bone.
录音中提到接下来要在中心柱周围建一个木制的脚手架塔（scaffold tower），对应选项I（scaffold）。
你可能会被前面出现的“ropes and pegs”或后面出现的“metal”干扰，但它们分别是固定柱子的材料或现代脚手架的材质，只有scaffold是建在柱子周围的结构。

To support the large roof, first you need to put up a good size center post, which is secured with ropes and pegs. But it's not only this which is relied upon to hold up the roof. So the next thing you have to do is build around the post a timber scaffold tower, similar to the metal ones used in Britain today.
录音中明确提到使用榛木杆子（hazel wood rods）连接到梁上来完成屋顶框架，对应选项E（hazel）。
你极有可能被前面的“willow tree”（柳树）干扰，但录音说的是“就像用柳条编篮子一样”，真正用来造屋顶的是榛木（hazel）。
Now the framework for the roof has to be completed. Rather like weaving a basket using rods from the willow tree, hazel wood rods are linked to the beams in parallel hoops.
录音提到要将芦苇捆切断，使它们每一根都长度相等（equal length），对应选项C（equal）。
这里只要不忽略整体语义，紧抓“cut them so that each is of...”后面的核心词，就不会错过“equal”。

The tricky bit is thatching the roof because it requires great skill. I find this very difficult. First, you take reed bundles and cut them so that each is of equal length. Then you must fix them firmly so they won't blow away in heavy winds.
